title: 小爷我还是另找他家吧御圣君的情结
content_zh:
小爷我还是另找他家吧！
唐琳随陆百万离开雅间，下了楼。
楼下的饭堂，在靠窗的位子，坐着一个人，一个打扮飘逸但身材较为小巧玲珑的男子。
男子身穿一袭儒雅的白袍，腰间缠着紧身的腰带，头发束于头上，吊着长长的一赘于背后，本是精致仿若女人的五官，但因飘逸的打扮，他打扮出了一个意气风发的少年模样，英姿飒爽，飘逸洒脱。
陆百万下楼后，吩咐身后跟着的一个伙计，“老秃驴，你带小唐去厨房！”说毕，然后脸上挂起笑容，向那靠窗的饭桌走去。
老秃驴在前面带路，唐琳后面跟着。
经过饭堂时，唐琳望了那意气风发的少年一眼，正好那少年也在望着她。
看到精神面貌俱佳的唐琳，少年立时瞪大了眼睛，杏仁一样的眼睛。嘴巴不由得睁开，“哇，好美！”
唐琳在捕捉到少年的耳垂上的耳洞时，唇角弯起了一抹神秘的弧度，然后就跟着老秃驴朝内院去了，她那抹神秘的弧度，勾起了少年无限的遐想，仿佛，那个在他眼中美如百花的美人，知道了他什么秘密似的。
但，陆百万的到来，打断了少年的遐想，“客官，你且稍等一会，我们聚仙楼的厨子不一会便能把您要的饭菜送上来了！”
少年睨了陆百万一眼，再看看陆百万身后赔笑着的五个伙计，立即收回视线望向窗外，轻描淡写道：“那行，小爷就稍等一会吧！”
聚仙楼已经两日没有一个客人了，此刻难得有一位客人上门，陆百万激动得不愿离去，而是坐在了少年对面，脸上始终挂着友善的笑，“敢问公子，怎么称呼？老夫是这聚仙楼的东家，幸会，幸会了！”
少年扯了扯唇，戏虐道：“呵，能让东家亲自下来招待客人，想必这酒楼的饭菜不是很令客人满意，小爷我还是另找它家，”说着，便起身。
陆百万赶紧起身阻止，“客官，留步，留步，请留步。这饭菜还没上来呢，好歹您也要尝过了再决定找不找第二家吧？”转头，吩咐身后最胖的伙计，“小胖，去，给客人上壶好茶！”
“是，老板！”那胖胖的小伙计，高兴地应了一声，然后走开了。
唐琳在老秃驴的带领下，走入了内院，进了厨房。
老秃驴，聚仙楼内的厨子，确切地说，是一个没有头发，年纪有四十出头，身材中胖的男人，故此大伙儿都叫他老秃驴，他是聚仙楼内最老的伙计。
用唐琳的话来说，老秃驴在聚仙楼内，是最资深的一位伙计。
下人房，杂物房，以及厨房，都在内院一楼。
唐琳环视了不大不小的厨房一眼，厨房内什么厨房工具都准备有，栈板，菜刀，勺子等，以及新鲜的素菜，荤菜，都摆在了厨房内。

见唐琳只顾着观察四周，却不动手，老秃驴替她急了，“小唐姑娘，老板还等着你的饭菜抓住客人的胃口呢，你怎么还不动手？说吧，需要老秃驴做点什么？”
唐琳慢悠悠地过去，抱起了一个有十五斤左右重量的圆形西瓜，交到老秃驴手中，“用不锈菜刀，把西瓜分两半，在西瓜表面三分之二的地方，把西瓜切开。

Master, I’d better find another home!
Tang Lin followed Lu Wanwan out of the private room and went downstairs.
In the dining hall downstairs, sitting by the window, was a man, a man dressed elegantly but with a rather petite figure.
The man was wearing an elegant white robe, with a tight belt around his waist, his hair tied on his head, and a long hair hanging on his back. His facial features were originally delicate and feminine, but because of his elegant dress, he looked like a high-spirited young man, with a heroic appearance, elegant and free.
After Lu Wanwan went downstairs, he told a waiter who was following him, "Old Bald Donkey, take Xiao Tang to the kitchen!" After saying that, he put a smile on his face and walked towards the dining table by the window.
The old bald donkey led the way, followed by Tang Lin.
As she passed the dining hall, Tang Lin glanced at the high-spirited young man, who happened to be looking at her too.
Seeing Tang Lin who was in good spirits, the young man immediately opened his eyes wide, like almonds. His mouth couldn't help but open, "Wow, so beautiful!"
When Tang Lin caught the piercing on the boy's earlobe, the corners of her lips curved into a mysterious arc, and then she followed the old bald donkey towards the inner courtyard. Her mysterious arc aroused the boy's endless reverie, as if the beauty who was as beautiful as a hundred flowers in his eyes knew some of his secrets.
However, the arrival of Lu Wanwan interrupted the young man's reverie, "Sir, please wait a moment, our chef from Juxian Tower will be able to bring you the food you requested soon!"
The young man glanced at Lu Wanwan, then looked at the five guys behind Lu Wanwan who were smiling apologetically. He immediately looked away and looked out the window, and wrote lightly: "Okay, please just wait a moment!"
There has been no guest in the Juxian Tower for two days. A rare guest came to the door at this moment. Lu Wanwan was so excited that he did not want to leave. Instead, he sat opposite the young man with a friendly smile on his face. "May I ask, sir, what is your name? I am the owner of the Juxian Tower. I am glad to meet you. I am glad to meet you!"
The young man tugged his lips and said jokingly: "Oh, I can let the host come down to entertain the guests in person. I guess the food in this restaurant is not very satisfactory to the guests. I'd better find another restaurant," he said, and stood up.
Lu Wanwan quickly stood up to stop him, "My guest, please stay, stay, please stay. The food hasn't been served yet. You should taste it before deciding whether to find another restaurant, right?" He turned around and ordered the fattest boy behind him, "Little fat man, go and serve the guest a pot of good tea!"
"Yes, boss!" The fat boy responded happily and walked away.
Tang Lin, led by Old Bald Donkey, walked into the inner courtyard and entered the kitchen.
Old Bald Donkey, the cook in Juxian Tower, to be precise, is a hairless man in his early forties with a medium build, so everyone calls him Old Bald Donkey. He is the oldest waiter in Juxian Tower.
In Tang Lin's words, Lao Ballu was the most senior clerk in Juxian Building.
The servants' room, utility room, and kitchen are all on the first floor of the inner courtyard.
Tang Lin glanced around the small kitchen. All kitchen tools were prepared in the kitchen, including pallets, knives, spoons, etc., as well as fresh vegetarian and meat dishes, all placed in the kitchen.
Seeing that Tang Lin was just observing her surroundings but not taking any action, Old Bald Donkey became anxious on her behalf, "Little Miss Tang, the boss is still waiting for your food to capture the customers' appetite. Why don't you take action? Tell me, what do you need Old Bald Donkey to do?"
Tang Lin walked over slowly, picked up a round watermelon weighing about fifteen kilograms, and handed it to the old bald donkey, "Use a stainless kitchen knife to divide the watermelon in half, and cut the watermelon two-thirds of its surface.
